content.title: Everything You Need to Know About Applying to Villanova University
content.text: Villanova University has an acceptance rate of 27%. Half the applicants admitted to Villanova who submitted test scores have an SAT score between 1395 and 1510 or an ACT score of 32 and 34. However, one quarter of admitted applicants achieved scores above these ranges and one quarter scored below these ranges. The application deadline at Villanova University is Jan. 15. Admissions officials at Villanova University consider a student's GPA a very important academic factor. An applicant's high school class rank, when available, is considered and letters of recommendation are considered important for admissions officials at Villanova University. To see additional academic factors along with other school data, learn more about College Compass.
